# T-3: Evaluate semantic acceptance

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Replace aggregate-only acceptance with exhaustive requirement-unit judgments over request, requirements, diff, repair audit, and fingerprint-matched test evidence.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Acceptance schema requires one judgment for every requirement id and rejects missing, duplicate, or unknown ids.
- Judgment classes enforce met, notMet, and notVerifiable evidence invariants.
- Mechanical evidence validity is checked before semantic judgment.
- All-met evidence promotes final-regression.

## Implementation Notes
Update run-acceptance-review, acceptance-review-artifacts, and the acceptance schema as one semantic producer/validator boundary. Read each source artifact through the existing 1 MiB per-file readBoundedSourceArtifact limit and reject larger inputs. Preserve fixture injection only where it exercises the public command without direct state mutation.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests validate schema and judgment invariants; integration tests exercise all-met, notMet, notVerifiable, mechanical blocker, and malformed judgment cases.
